# situation: the first step uses a composite action of example-org/ci-tools
#   pinned to a full SHA, whose action.yml uses actions/github-script@v7;
#   the second step names example-org/ci-tools by a full SHA, but its path
#   goes with .. above the root of the repository, to
#   actions/github-script/v7.
# reason: the runner puts each action of the job, a composite action's own
#   uses among them, in _actions/<owner>/<repo>/<ref>, and reads the path of
#   the second step from the directory of example-org/ci-tools there; the
#   second step runs actions/github-script at the tag v7, not an action of
#   example-org/ci-tools.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: example-org/ci-tools/setup@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - uses: example-org/ci-tools/../../../actions/github-script/v7@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          script: console.log("done")
